title: Guess before reveal
summary: Invite the viewer to commit to a guess, then reveal the answer later in the film.
fits: There is a single answer the viewer can plausibly predict (and often predicts wrong).
The surprise of being wrong is itself the lesson.
Pacing allows a beat of thinking time before the reveal.
avoid: The topic is open-ended or has no single answer to guess.
The guess would be a trick question with no fair path to it.
The film is a calm walkthrough where a quiz beat breaks the mood.
